subject: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps

Hi Samir / Olivia -

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: Acme wants to add an LLM-powered assist for sales reps (live summarization + retrieval-augmented responses).
- Traffic profile: pilot ~50k tokens/day, production target ~1.2M tokens/day in Q4.
- Key requirements: SOC 2 evidence, enterprise-grade SLA, VPC/private deployment option for regulated PII flows.

Stakeholders you mentioned:
- Economic buyer: Olivia Grant (final sign-off on budget)
- Security/Privacy: Priya Natarajan (legal/security) - procurement will coordinate evidence requests
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com (PO + SOW)

Requested next steps: 
1) We will share SOC 2 and architecture doc (sensitive link) and a draft SOW by EOD tomorrow.
2) Please confirm procurement timeline and any specific legal redlines to expect.
3) Can we schedule a 30-min procurement/technical follow-up next week (we're flexible Wed/Thu morning PT)?

One ask from your side: please confirm whether the decision criteria prioritize (in order) SLA uptime > cost > data residency, or if pricing is the main driver.

Attachments we will send: SOC2 report, draft SOW, procurement checklist.

Thanks - I'll follow up internally on availability for any deviation on pricing/SLA before our next call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_sow_acme_v1.docx]
[Attachment: soc2_report_q1_2026.pdf]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-03-15T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps

Thanks Marissa - good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

Stakeholders + timeline:
- Olivia (economic buyer) will confirm budget by 3/30; final contract needs CFO sign-off.
- Priya Natarajan (security/legal) will run the compliance questionnaire - she expects our SOC2 and an encryption summary.
- Procurement (procurement@acme.com) handles PO and PO lead times (usually 2-3 weeks once legal signs off).

Decision criteria (rough ordering):
1) Security & compliance (SOC2, encryption at-rest/in-transit, data segmentation)
2) SLA & reliability (we need 99.9% during business hours; is that possible?)
3) Pricing (TCO over 12 months)

On SLA: Olivia asked whether Redwood can make an exception to the standard 99.95% SLA for dedicated/private deployments and sign 99.9% for our use case - we can be flexible if the pricing and deployment model match.

Attached is our procurement checklist (for your ops/legal). Can you flag any items we should expect to take longer?

Samir
Director, Product Operations, Acme Inc.
[Attachment: procurement_checklist_acme.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-16T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - request: discount + SLA exception

Team - forwarding Acme's procurement checklist and SLA ask. Quick ask: they are asking for a 99.9% business-hours SLA (we typically offer 99.95% for Dedicated; hosted tiers vary). They are a strategic mid-market account with potential to scale quickly.

Pricing ask: they sign in Q2 if we can shave ~20% off list for first 12 months (pilot + committed capacity).

Please advise on the following by EOD: 
- Pricing: can we approve up to 20% off list for ACME-2026-07? If not, what's the max discount without VP approval?
- SLA: can we offer 99.9% as a documented deviation for Dedicated/Private? Any legal/security flags?
- Security evidence: Priya requested SOC2 + encryption summary. Dev - can we provide the encryption summary + architecture diagram?

Thanks - I want to reply to Samir with concrete terms tomorrow morning so procurement can schedule PO timelines.

-Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - request: discount + SLA exception

Marissa -

Short answers: 
- Discount: Approve up to 15% off list without further VP approval. Any discount >15% requires VP (me) sign-off in written approval; >25% requires CRO approval. If they need 20% we can escalate but prefer to start at 15% and show flexibility on term/commitment length.
- SLA: Legal needs to review any SLA deviation. We can offer a documented exception to 99.9% for Dedicated deployments, but it must include: liability cap alignment, maintenance blackout windows, and service credits formula. Legal will produce the exception language.
- Security evidence: Dev, can you push SOC2 + an encryption summary and the private-deployment architecture diagram to the secure drive link and flag anything that triggers a security exception?

Laura - please coordinate CS handoff if they move to pilot; include runbook for onboarding.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-18T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: stakeholder mapping & procurement next steps - Redwood follow-up and next steps

Hi Samir / Olivia -

Thanks for the checklist and the clarity on decision criteria. Quick update after internal sync: 

1) Discount - we can commit to a 15% discount off list pricing for the first 12 months for an initial Dedicated pilot + 12-month committed capacity. If you need 20% we can escalate to Rishi for VP approval but prefer to land at 15% + a commitment term.

2) SLA - legal is prepared to document a 99.9% business-hours SLA exception for Dedicated/Private deployments. That exception will include the usual liability cap and service-credit schedule; we'll send proposed exception language with the SOW.

3) Security evidence - attaching our SOC2 report and we have uploaded an encryption + architecture summary to a secure link: https://drive.redwood.example/soc2_ACME_q1_2026. Please have Priya review and let us know any gaps.

4) Next steps: 
- I'll share a draft SOW (attached) with the 15% pricing and SLA exception clause for procurement review.
- Can we schedule a 30-min procurement/legal call on Wed 3/24 at 10am PT to review redlines?
- Please confirm PO timing once legal signs off so we can align onboarding dates.

Attachments: SOC2 report, draft SOW, procurement checklist (from your side).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
